responsibility: Implements default-channel raw storage transfer by forwarding directly to RawIO with StdChans.StdInChan and StdChans.StdOutChan. Its responsibility is limited to providing the ISO standard-stream façade for raw reads and writes rather than owning buffer management or device logic.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements the SRawIO entry points by calling RawIO.Read and RawIO.Write with StdChans standard channels. It differs from SRawIO.def, which only defines the raw default-channel API and parameter types.
